title: PHASMOPHOBIA COMMUNITY RAISES OVER $230,000 FOR AMERICAN HEART ASSOCIATION IN RECORD-BREAKING GHOST HUNTS FOR HEARTS CAMPAIGN! - Lifestyle
excerpt: The Phasmophobia community has demonstrated that ghost hunting can make a difference beyond the virtual world, raising more than $230,000 for the American Heart Association through the hugely successful Ghost Hunts for Hearts 2026 charity campaign.
content:
The Phasmophobia community has demonstrated that ghost hunting can make a difference beyond the virtual world, raising more than $230,000 for the American Heart Association through the hugely successful Ghost Hunts for Hearts 2026 charity campaign.

Developer Kinetic Games has confirmed that this year’s fundraising event more than doubled the $100,000+ raised in 2025, marking another major milestone for the popular cooperative horror game and its dedicated community.

Running from 26 October to 2 November 2026, the week-long campaign brought together more than 500 streamers, setting a new participation record for a creator fundraising campaign supported by Heart Liive, an American Heart Association initiative.

The event combined livestreamed paranormal investigations, community fundraising and exclusive in-game rewards, encouraging players and viewers worldwide to support an important cause.

More Than 500 Phasmophobia Streamers Unite For Charity!

This year’s Ghost Hunts for Hearts campaign represented a significant step forward for Kinetic Games and the wider Phasmophobia community.

Organised with support from Heart Liive, the initiative encouraged content creators to turn their ghost-hunting livestreams into fundraising opportunities, allowing audiences to contribute directly to the American Heart Association’s mission of improving cardiovascular health and saving lives.

Throughout the campaign, participating streamers explored Phasmophobia’s haunted environments, investigated supernatural activity and entertained their communities while raising money.

The response exceeded expectations, with over 500 streamers registering to participate.

According to Kinetic Games, this represented the largest number of creators ever involved in a Heart Liive fundraising campaign.

The impressive turnout also highlighted the growing role of gaming communities in charitable fundraising, demonstrating how livestreaming platforms can bring thousands of viewers together around a shared cause.

Phasmophobia Players Unlock Exclusive Twitch Drop Rewards!

To celebrate the campaign and encourage participation, Kinetic Games introduced a special Ghost Hunts for Hearts Twitch Drop.

Viewers watching eligible fundraising streams throughout the event could unlock the exclusive Advocate ID Card and Badge, allowing them to show their support for the campaign inside Phasmophobia.

The rewards provided an additional incentive for players to discover participating content creators, engage with the charity initiative and support the fundraising efforts.

However, the developer had another surprise planned.

At the beginning of the campaign on 26 October, Kinetic Games announced an ambitious fundraising target of $200,000.

If the community reached the milestone, every Phasmophobia player would unlock an animated version of the Advocate ID Card and Badge set.

With the final fundraising total surpassing $230,000, the community successfully achieved the target, unlocking the animated cosmetic rewards for all players.

The achievement added another celebratory moment to an already successful campaign, rewarding the collective efforts of streamers, viewers and players.

Kinetic Games Celebrates Record-Breaking Fundraising Achievement!

Following the announcement, Kinetic Games praised the dedication and generosity of the Phasmophobia community.

Tom Dent, Lead Social Media & Player Experience Manager at Kinetic Games, said:

“The Phasmophobia community never fails to amaze us, and this year they’ve outdone themselves. Doubling last year’s total and seeing more than 500 streamers come together for a cause that matters is incredible. Thank you to every streamer, viewer and player who took part, and to our friends at Heart Liive for helping make it happen.”

The campaign’s success reflects the strength of the relationship between the developer and its player base, which has continued to support Phasmophobia since the game’s early access launch in September 2020.

What exploded in popularity as a cooperative ghost-hunting experience has developed into a global gaming community, with charity initiatives such as Ghost Hunts for Hearts providing opportunities for players to come together beyond the game’s usual supernatural investigations.

American Heart Association Praises Gaming Community’s Support!

The American Heart Association also celebrated the campaign’s success, highlighting the potential of gaming and content creation to support charitable causes.

Heart Liive works with creators and their audiences to raise funds and awareness for the organisation’s mission, helping turn online communities into powerful fundraising networks.

Hayli Baez, Senior National Lead for Heart Liive, said:

“Ghost Hunts for Hearts shows what’s possible when content creation meets cause. We’re grateful to Kinetic Games and every creator, viewer and player who raised lifesaving funds and supported the American Heart Association’s mission to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives.”

The $230,000+ raised during the 2026 campaign represents a substantial increase over the previous year’s total and establishes a new benchmark for future Ghost Hunts for Hearts events.

What Is Phasmophobia?

Developed by Southampton-based Kinetic Games, Phasmophobia is a cooperative psychological horror game that challenges teams of up to four players to investigate paranormal activity across a variety of haunted locations.

Players use specialist ghost-hunting equipment, including EMF readers, spirit boxes and other investigative tools, to gather supernatural evidence and identify the entities haunting each environment.

Since launching into early access in September 2020, the game has attracted millions of players worldwide, becoming a recognisable title within the multiplayer horror genre.

Its combination of unpredictable ghost encounters, atmospheric environments and cooperative gameplay has also made it particularly popular among livestreamers and content creators.

The success of Ghost Hunts for Hearts demonstrates how that same community spirit can extend beyond gameplay, bringing players together to support causes that make a difference in the real world.

A New Milestone For Ghost Hunts For Hearts

With more than $230,000 raised, over 500 participating streamers and the campaign’s $200,000 fundraising goal surpassed, Ghost Hunts for Hearts 2026 has become a landmark event for Kinetic Games and Heart Liive.

The fundraising achievement also shows how gaming communities can transform their passion for entertainment into meaningful charitable action.

For the Phasmophobia community, this year’s ghost hunts delivered something even more rewarding than identifying a supernatural entity: an opportunity to help support lifesaving work.

Players can find out more about the game through the official Phasmophobia website and learn more about the charity’s work through the American Heart Association.
